page.overview:
Who is Adelphel de Chevraudan?

Ser Adelphel de Chevraudan, also known as Ser Adelphel Brightblade, is a character in Final Fantasy XIV. He is the youngest of the Heavens' Ward.

Though born to a lesser house, Ser Adelphel was a formidable fighter and admired for his elegant swordsmanship. He trained rigorously from an early age at the behest of his father, who believed it would help him excel in high society. Having mastered the combat arts, he won much glory on the battlefield and secured a place within the archbishop's personal guard.

Ser Adelphel rose to great prominence and attracted the attention of countless young noble-women, many with whom he was rumored to have had relations. The knowledge that he had sworn an oath to never marry or father children seemed only to inflame their passions further, and the young knight found himself challenged to duels by disgruntled husbands, brothers, and fathers with alarming frequency.

Ser Adelphel confronted the Warrior of Light in the Vault, attempting to halt their. Defeated even after transforming into a large, inhuman knight, Ser Adelphel escaped to the Inner Sanctum.
